title: Careem Food launches catering service in the UAE
text:
Careem Food launches catering service in the UAE
Careem, the region’s leading Everything App, has launched Careem Food Catering, a new service giving customers across Dubai and Abu Dhabi access to 20+ of the UAE's top caterers through a single, seamless booking experience on the Careem app.
The launch lands at the height of UAE summer, when everyone comes together indoors and homes become the venue of choice. From weekend family lunches and birthday celebrations to movie or game nights, and office get-togethers, summer is one of the busiest seasons for home hosting in the region, and Careem Food Catering is built to make feeding a crowd the easiest part of the plan.
The service was developed in direct response to data from Careem’s own platform. Over recent months, the company has seen a consistent spike in large group orders, office catering requests and repeat catering-related searches, signalling a clear demand for a more convenient, app-based hosting experience.
Unlike standard group orders, which are typically placed for immediate delivery, Careem Food Catering is built for planning ahead using our scheduling feature. Customers can place orders between 24 and 72 hours in advance depending on the caterer, and can book for events happening up to 15 days away. Every caterer on the service offers menus designed specifically for large groups, whether that's a gathering of 10 or a celebration of 60, making it far simpler to order for a crowd than piecing together individual dishes. Minimum orders start from AED 350.
The selection is also designed around how people actually host. Customers can choose family-style feasting with generous shared plates, finger food suited to standing receptions and office events, or live stations and carts that bring the experience straight to the venue. Selected caterers even offer waiter service, so hosts can spend the evening with their guests while the caterer handles all the details.
Nourhan Farhat, VP of Marketplace Businesses at Careem, said: “Food is at the heart of every gathering, and we wanted to make that part effortless. Summer in the UAE is when hosting really comes alive. Everyone heads indoors, and homes turn into the place where friends and family come together. And yet, in one of the most digitally engaged markets in the world, catering has stayed a surprisingly offline experience. With Careem Food Catering, we're giving people in Dubai and Abu Dhabi access to the best caterers in their city, with the same ease and reliability they already trust us for. This summer, and for every occasion after, we want Careem to be the first place people turn to when they're hosting.”
Danish Irfan Gaya, Director of Gazebo, added: "Catering has always been about creating memorable experiences, but reaching the right customers at the right moment has been a real challenge. Partnering with Careem changes that. Their platform gives us direct access to customers across Dubai and Abu Dhabi, and their reliability means we can focus on what we do best. We're proud to be part of this launch."
This initial rollout marks phase one of Careem’s catering expansion, with plans to onboard more culinary partners, introduce specialised menu customisations, and expand the service to additional Emirates in the coming months.
Careem Food Catering is available now on the Careem app in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
Background Information
CAREEM
Careem is the technology platform for our region. A region of over 600 million people that extends from Morocco to Pakistan, Turkey to Sudan. It’s an area of the world that up until now, has largely missed out on the transformational power of the internet revolution – but through its ambition and focus is catching up fast. Half of the population are under 25, and the same amount are connected to the internet yet only a small proportion have bank accounts, access to public transport and critical infrastructure.
